optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Retail Store Operations

Ran pilot‑store test rounds with store staff in three pilot stores before each release, recording outcomes per scenario and escalating blocking defects to the development lead. (src_eff4ecc98aa8)

Wrote release notes for store operations, listing known limitations (the task‑photo feature needed the newer device model) and hand‑over items for the store support desk. (src_b3afd255903c)
experienceHighlights: Maintained automated test suite for handheld fleet (Appium) and added offline‑sync scenarios. (src_fa616aacd166)
Conducted pilot‑store test rounds in three stores before each release, recording outcomes and escalating blocking defects. (src_eff4ecc98aa8)
Prepared release readiness summaries and coordinated sign‑off with store systems manager and development lead. (src_282a82db7240)
Authored release notes documenting known limitations and hand‑over items. (src_b3afd255903c)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Appium suite scenario list and pilot‑store round results sheet with device‑farm run identifiers as verification trail. (src_c92c96538091)
